title: Reductions on non-contiguous inputs took the slow generic path
notes: Part of the largest cluster of MPS reduction work in the window: #191097 inner-dim, #191098 strided/batched outer + small-dim + narrow, #191099 argmax/argmin strided and split-K, #191100 min/max off MPSGraph, #191101 skip input up-casts + vec4 full reductions, #191104 int64 min/max over partial simdgroups. All first appear in 2.14.0, so the 2.13->2.14 reduction geomean is the headline validation of this suite.
